candidates.label: Guidance mechanics: breast expansion for Islam versus constriction as though climbing sky; Allah places rijs upon non-believers
candidates.definition: In 6:125: So whoever Allah wants to guide He expands his breast to Islam and whoever He wants to misguide He makes his breast tight and constricted as though he were climbing into the sky. Thus does Allah place defilement upon those who do not believe.

evidence.excerpt: فَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَهۡدِيَهُۥ يَشۡرَحۡ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِۖ وَمَن يُرِدۡ أَن يُضِلَّهُۥ يَجۡعَلۡ صَدۡرَهُۥ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجٗا كَأَنَّمَا يَصَّعَّدُ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّجۡسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Faman yuridi Allahu an yahdiyahu yashrah sadrahu lilislami waman yurid an yudillahu yajAAal sadrahu dayyiqan harajan kaannama yassaAAAAadu fee alssamai kathalika yajAAalu Allahu alrrijsa AAala allatheena la yuminoona: phenomenological description of guidance as experiential opening and misguidance as suffocating constriction with rijs as divine placement.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Guidance-misguidance asymmetry rooted in divine will
Breast-expansion as spiritual capacity enabling reception of Islam

candidates.urduLabel: آليات الهداية: شرح الصدر للإسلام مقابل الضيق والحرج كأنما يصعد في السماء؛ الله يجعل الرجس على الذين لا يؤمنون
candidates.notes: Overlap with tawheed and god-consciousness. Yashrah sadrahu lilislami provides the most vivid Quranic metaphor for guidance-as-experiential-opening contrasting sharply with intellectual assent models. Dayyiqan harajan paired with climbing-sky simile renders misguidance sensorially immediate rather than abstractly punitive. Rijs-placement frames impurity as consequence of persistent disbelief not inherent nature. This verse establishes that guidance operates through affective transformation not merely cognitive persuasion.

candidates.label: Dar al-Salam reward and jinn-mankind joint accountability: Home of Peace with Lord as protecting friend; Day gathering jinn and mankind mutual exploitation confessed Fire residence eternal except Allah wills Wise Knowing; messengers warned self-witness against selves worldly life deluded
candidates.definition: In 6:127-130: For them will be the Home of Peace with their Lord and He will be their protecting friend because of what they used to do. And the Day when He will gather them together O company of jinn you have misled many of mankind and their allies among mankind will say Our Lord some of us made use of others and we have reached our term which you appointed for us. He will say The Fire is your residence wherein you will abide eternally except for what Allah wills. Indeed your Lord is Wise and Knowing. O company of jinn and mankind did there not come to you messengers from among you relating My verses and warning you of this Day? They will say We bear witness against ourselves and the worldly life had deluded them and they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.

evidence.excerpt: ۞لَهُمۡ دَارُ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۖ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Lahum daru alssalami AAinda rabbihim wahuwa waliyyuhum bima kanoo yaAAmaloona: Dar al-Salam as unique eschatological reward-name with divine wilayah conditioned on deeds.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعٗا يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ قَدِ ٱسۡتَكۡثَرۡتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِۖ وَقَالَ أَوۡلِيَآؤُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ رَبَّنَا ٱسۡتَمۡتَعَ بَعۡضُنَا بِبَعۡضٖ وَبَلَغۡنَآ أَجَلَنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَجَّلۡتَ لَنَاۚ قَالَ ٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوَىٰكُمۡ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Wayawma yahshuruhum jameeAAan ya maAAshara aljinni qadi istakthartum mina alinsi...alnnaru mathwakum khalideena feeha illa ma shaa Allahu inna rabbaka hakeemun AAaleemun: only explicit Quranic scene of joint jinn-mankind species-accountability with mutual exploitation (istikthar) confessed and Fire-residence decreed.

evidence.excerpt: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٞ مِّنكُمۡ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِي وَيُنذِرُونَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَاۚ قَالُواْ شَهِدۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِنَاۖ وَغَرَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَشَهِدُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ أَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ كَٰفِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi alam yatikum rusulun minkum...qaloo shahidna AAala anfusina wagharrathumu alhayatu alddunya washahidoo AAala anfusihim annahum kanoo kafireena: prophetic warning confirmed by self-witness eliminating external accusation with worldly-delusion diagnosis.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Joint species judgment scene unique in Quran
Dar al-Salam as eschatological reward and Fire as punishment

candidates.urduLabel: دار السلام والمسؤولية المشتركة للجن والإنس: دار السلام عند ربهم وهو وليهم؛ يوم يحشر الجن والإنس استكثار متبادل النار مثواهم خالدين إلا ما شاء الله حكيم عليم؛ الرسل أنذروا شهادة على الأنفس الحياة الدنيا غرتهم
candidates.notes: Overlap with day-of-judgment and the-hereafter. Dar al-Salam appears uniquely here as named eschatological destination distinguishing it from generic jannah references. Istikthar (mutual excessive exploitation) between jinn and mankind reveals cross-species alliance as structural feature of misguidance not incidental temptation. Self-witness (shahidna AAala anfusina) eliminates prosecutorial need making judgment self-evident. Illa ma shaa Allahu exception clause in Fire-residence raises theological questions about duration deferred to scholarly review. Gharrathumu alhayatu alddunya identifies worldly delusion as root cause preceding confession.

candidates.label: Fabricated taboos and child-killing beautification: partners beautified killing children causing destruction confusing religion; livestock crops reserved backs forbidden name-omission fabrication; lost those who killed children foolishly forbade provision fabricating lie gone astray
candidates.definition: In 6:137-140: And likewise to many of the polytheists their partners have made pleasing the killing of their children in order to bring about their destruction and to cover them with confusion in their religion. And if Allah had willed they would not have done so so leave them and that which they invent. And they say These animals and crops are forbidden no one may eat from them except whom we will by their claim. And there are those whose backs are forbidden and those upon which the name of Allah is not mentioned an invention of untruth about Him. He will punish them for what they were inventing. Those will have lost who killed their children in foolishness without knowledge and prohibited what Allah had provided for them inventing untruth about Allah. They have gone astray and were not rightly guided.

evidence.excerpt: وَكَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ قَتۡلَ أَوۡلَٰدِهِمۡ شُرَكَآؤُهُمۡ لِيُرۡدُوهُمۡ وَلِيَلۡبِسُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ دِينَهُمۡۖ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُۖ فَذَرۡهُمۡ وَمَا يَفۡتَرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wakathalika zayyana likatheerin mina almushrikeena qatla awladihim shurakaohum liyurdoohum waliyalbisoo AAalayhim deenahum walaw shaa Allahu ma faAAaloohu fatharhum wama yaftaroona: aesthetic manipulation (zayyana) identified as mechanism enabling infanticide with dual destructive purpose.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالُواْ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَنۡعَٰمٞ وَحَرۡثٌ حِجۡرٞ لَّا يَطۡعَمُهَآ إِلَّا مَن نَّشَآءُ بِزَعۡمِهِمۡ وَأَنۡعَٰمٌ حُرِّمَتۡ ظُهُورُهَا وَأَنۡعَٰمٞ لَّا يَذۡكُرُونَ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهَا ٱفۡتِرَآءً عَلَيۡهِۚ سَيَجۡزِيهِم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Waqaloo hathihi anAAamun waharthun hijrun la yatAAamuha illa man nashao bizaAAmihim waanAAamun hurrimat thuhooruha waanAAamun la yathkuroona isma Allahi AAalayha iftiraan AAalayhi sayajzeehim bima kanoo yaftaroona: systematic catalogue of fabricated prohibitions covering food reservation riding restriction and name-omission all labelled iftiraan.

evidence.excerpt: قَدۡ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَتَلُوٓاْ أَوۡلَٰدَهُمۡ سَفَهَۢا بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَحَرَّمُواْ مَا رَزَقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱفۡتِرَآءً عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ قَدۡ ضَلُّواْ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُهۡتَدِينَ
evidence.rationale: Qad khasira allatheena qataloo awladahum safahan bighayri AAilmin waharramoo ma razaqahumu Allahu iftiraan AAala Allahi qad dalloo wama kanoo muhtadeena: loss-diagnosis linking child-killing and provision-prohibition as twin fabrications producing straying.

Infanticide condemned as loss-producing foolishness

candidates.urduLabel: التحريمات المفتعلة وتزيين قتل الأولاد: شركاؤهم زينوا لهم قتل أولادهم ليردوهم ويلبسوا عليهم دينهم؛ أنعام وحرث حجر ظهور محرمة عدم ذكر اسم الله افتراء؛ خسر الذين قتلوا أولادهم سفهاً بغير علم وحرموا ما رزقهم الله افتراءاً ضلوا وما كانوا مهتدين
candidates.notes: Overlap with shirk-prohibition and right-to-life. Zayyana (beautification) identifies aesthetic manipulation as primary mechanism enabling atrocities linking to 6:112 zukhruf motif. Liyurdoohum waliyalbisoo reveals dual satanic purpose: physical destruction plus religious confusion preventing recovery. Hijr (reservation) documents pre-Islamic Arabian religious innovation systematically. Safahan bighayri AAilmin diagnoses infanticide as ignorant foolishness not calculated pragmatism. Khasira-dalloo pairing establishes comprehensive loss spanning both worldly welfare and spiritual direction.

candidates.label: Agricultural ethics and harvest due: gardens trellised untrellised palm crops olive pomegranate similar dissimilar eat fruit give due harvest day not excessive; grazing livestock carriers small eat provided follow not Satan footsteps clear enemy
candidates.definition: In 6:141-142: And He it is who causes gardens to grow trellised and untrellised and palm trees and crops of different kinds of food and olives and pomegranates similar and dissimilar. Eat of its fruit when it yields and give its due on the day of its harvest. And be not excessive. Indeed He does not like those who commit excess. And of the grazing livestock are carriers and those too small. Eat of what Allah has provided for you and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed he is to you a clear enemy.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَ جَنَّـٰتٖ مَّعۡرُوشَٰتٖ وَغَيۡرَ مَعۡرُوشَٰتٖ وَٱلنَّخۡلَ وَٱلزَّرۡعَ مُخۡتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُۥ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَٰبِهٗا وَغَيۡرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٖۚ كُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثۡمَرَ وَءَاتُواْ حَقَّهُۥ يَوۡمَ حَصَادِهِۦۖ وَلَا تُسۡرِفُوٓاْۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
evidence.rationale: Wahuwa allathee anshaa jannatin maAArooshatin waghayra maAArooshatin waalnnakhla waalzzarAAa mukhtalifan okuluhu waalzzaytoona waalrrummana mutashabihan waghayra mutashabihin kuloo min thamarihi itha athmara waatoo haqqahu yawma hasadihi wala tusrifoo innahu la yuhibbu almusrifeena: agricultural catalogue integrating biodiversity appreciation with harvest-due obligation and excess-prohibition establishing ethical framework for consumption.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ حَمُولَةٗ وَفَرۡشٗاۚ كُلُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُواْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
evidence.rationale: Wamina alanAAami hamoolatan wafarshan kuloo mimma razaqakumu Allahu wala tattabiAAoo khutuwati alshshaytani innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun: livestock categorization with permission-command and Satan-footsteps prohibition framing dietary practice within cosmic enmity.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Harvest-due as agricultural zakat precursor
Israf-prohibition establishing consumption limits

candidates.urduLabel: الأخلاق الزراعية وحق الحصاد: جنات معروشات وغير معروشات والنخل والزرع مختلف أكله والزيتون والرمان متشابه وغير متشابه كلوا من ثمره وآتوا حقه يوم حصاده ولا تسرفوا؛ الأنعام حمولة وفرشاً كلوا مما رزقكم الله ولا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان عدو مبين
candidates.notes: Overlap with giving and balance-moderation. MaAArooshatin waghayra maAArooshatin demonstrates taxonomic awareness distinguishing cultivation methods. Mukhtalifan okuluhu celebrates food-diversity as divine design. Waatoo haqqahu yawma hasadihi links consumption-permission to immediate social obligation preventing hoarding. Wala tusrifoo establishes moderation principle applicable beyond food. Hamoolatan wafarshan distinguishes working animals from meat-sources recognizing functional differentiation. Khutuwati alshshaytani frames dietary transgression as following satanic trajectory not isolated error.

candidates.label: Four dietary prohibitions and necessity exception: nothing forbidden except dead animal spilled blood swine flesh impure disobedience dedicated other than Allah; forced neither desiring transgressing Forgiving Merciful
candidates.definition: In 6:145: Say I do not find within that which was revealed to me anything forbidden to one who would eat it unless it be a dead animal or blood spilled out or the flesh of swine for indeed it is impure or it be disobedience dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced neither desiring nor transgressing then indeed your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: قُل لَّآ أَجِدُ فِي مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَىٰ طَاعِمٖ يَطۡعَمُهُۥٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَكُونَ مَيۡتَةً أَوۡ دَمٗا مَّسۡفُوحًا أَوۡ لَحۡمَ خِنزِيرٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ رِجۡسٌ أَوۡ فِسۡقًا أُهِلَّ لِغَيۡرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦۚ فَمَنِ ٱضۡطُرَّ غَيۡرَ بَاغٖ وَلَا عَادٖ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Qul la ajidu fee ma oohiya ilayya muharraman AAala taAAimin yatAAamuhu illa an yakoona maytatan aw daman masfoohan aw lahma khinzeerin fainnahu rijsun aw fisqan ohilla lighayri Allahi bihi famani idturra ghayra baghin wala AAadin fainna rabbaka ghafoorun raheemun: canonical four-prohibition list with rijs-designation for swine and dual-condition necessity exception balanced by Ghafoor-Raheem closure.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Most concise dietary law summary in Quran
Necessity exception demonstrating divine compassion within legal strictness

candidates.urduLabel: المحرمات الغذائية الأربع واستثناء الضرورة: لا محرم إلا ميتة أو دم مسفوح أو لحم خنزير رجس أو فسق أهل لغير الله به؛ اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد فإن ربك غفور رحيم
candidates.notes: Overlap with halal-food and mercy-and-forgiveness. La ajidu fee ma oohiya ilayya grounds prohibitions in revelation not custom distinguishing Islamic from pre-Islamic dietary law. Maytatan daman masfoohan lahma khinzeerin fisqan provides exhaustive canonical list referenced elsewhere. Fainnahu rijsun singles out swine as inherently impure unlike other prohibitions based on circumstance. Ghayra baghin wala AAadin prevents necessity-exception abuse through dual intent-condition. Ghafoorun raheemun balances legal precision with pastoral reassurance preventing scrupulosity.

candidates.label: Recited decalogue and three purpose clauses: associate nothing parents good treatment kill not children poverty approach not immoralities apparent hidden kill not soul except right instructed reason; orphan property best way full measure weight justice speak just even relative fulfill covenant instructed remember; My straight path follow follow not paths scatter instructed fear
candidates.definition: In 6:151-153: Say Come I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you that you not associate anything with Him and to parents good treatment and do not kill your children out of poverty We will provide for you and them and do not approach immoralities what is apparent and what is concealed and do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden except by right. This has He instructed you that you may use reason. And do not approach the orphan's property except in a way that is best until he reaches maturity. And give full measure and weight in justice. We do not charge any soul except within its capacity. And when you testify be just even if it concerns a near relative. And the covenant of Allah fulfill. This has He instructed you that you may remember. And this is My path which is straight so follow it and do not follow other ways for you will be separated from His way. This has He instructed you that you may become righteous.

evidence.excerpt: ۞قُلۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ أَتۡلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ أَلَّا تُشۡرِكُواْ بِهِۦ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَٰنٗاۖ وَلَا تَقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَوۡلَٰدَكُم مِّنۡ إِمۡلَٰقٖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكُمۡ وَإِيَّاهُمۡۖ وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ ٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنۡهَا وَمَا بَطَنَۖ وَلَا تَقۡتُلُواْ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Qul taAAalaw atlu ma harrama rabbukum AAalaykum alla tushrikoo bihi shayan wabialwalidayni ihsanan wala taqtuloo awladakum min imlaqin nahnu narzuqukum waiyyahum wala taqraboo alfawahisha ma thahara minha wama batana wala taqtuloo alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi thalikum wassakum bihi laAAallakum taAAqiloona: first five commands with reason-purpose clause establishing tawheed-parents-life-sexual ethics foundation.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ مَالَ ٱلۡيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥۚ وَأَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۖ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۖ وَإِذَا قُلۡتُمۡ فَٱعۡدِلُواْ وَلَوۡ كَانَ ذَا قُرۡبَىٰۖ وَبِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡفُواْۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wala taqraboo mala alyateemi illa biallatee hiya ahsanu hatta yablugha ashuddahu waawfoo alkayla waalmeezana bialqisti la nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waitha qultum faiAAdiloo walaw kana tha qurba wabiAAahdi Allahi awfoo thalikum wassakum bihi laAAallakum tathakkaroona: second set covering orphan-property market-integrity speech-justice covenant with remembrance-purpose clause.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطِي مُسۡتَقِيمٗا فَٱتَّبِعُوهُۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُواْ ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمۡ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
evidence.rationale: Waanna hatha siratee mustaqeeman faittabiAAoohu wala tattabiAAoo alssubula fatafarraqa bikum AAan sabeelihi thalikum wassakum bihi laAAallakum tattaqoona: single-path command versus scattering subul with taqwa-purpose clause completing progressive instruction sequence.

Market and judicial integrity embedded within divine command structure
Parental ihsan positioned immediately after tawheed establishing priority hierarchy

candidates.urduLabel: الوصايا المتلوة وغاياتها الثلاث: ألا تشركوا به شيئاً وبالوالدين إحساناً ولا تقتلوا أولادكم من إملاق ولا تقربوا الفواحش ما ظهر منها وما بطن ولا تقتلوا النفس التي حرم الله إلا بالحق وصاكم به لعلكم تعقلون؛ ولا تقربوا مال اليتيم إلا بالتي هي أحسن وأوفوا الكيل والميزان بالقسط وإذا قلتم فاعدلوا وبعهد الله أوفوا وصاكم به لعلكم تذكرون؛ هذا صراطي مستقيماً فاتبعوه ولا تتبعوا السبل وصاكم به لعلكم تتقون
candidates.notes: Overlap with good-character justice and parents-and-family. TaAAalaw atlu frames these as recited divine commands not human wisdom. Alla tushrikoo bihi shayan opens with absolute tawheed anchoring all subsequent ethics. Wabialwalidayni ihsanan places parental goodness second establishing intergenerational bond as foundational social unit. Min imlaqin nahnu narzuqukum waiyyahum addresses poverty-driven infanticide with provision-guarantee replacing mere prohibition. Ma thahara minha wama batana demands comprehensive sexual ethics covering public and private. Illa bialhaqq limits lethal force to legitimate authority. LaAAallakum taAAqiloona-tathakkaroona-tattaqoona forms progressive pedagogical sequence from reasoning through memory to God-consciousness. Siratee mustaqeeman claims divine ownership of the path while alssubula warns against plural alternatives.

candidates.label: Jewish dietary restrictions as punitive recompense: every clawed animal forbidden cattle sheep fat except backs entrails bone-mixed recompensed transgression truthful
candidates.definition: In 6:146: And to those who are Jews We prohibited every animal of uncloven hoof and of the cattle and the sheep We prohibited to them their fat except what adheres to their backs or the entrails or what is joined with bone. By that We repaid them for their injustice. And indeed We are truthful.

evidence.excerpt: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ حَرَّمۡنَا كُلَّ ذِي ظُفُرٖۖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡبَقَرِ وَٱلۡغَنَمِ حَرَّمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ شُحُومَهُمَآ إِلَّا مَا حَمَلَتۡ ظُهُورُهُمَآ أَوِ ٱلۡحَوَايَآ أَوۡ مَا ٱخۡتَلَطَ بِعَظۡمٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيۡنَٰهُم بِبَغۡيِهِمۡۖ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
evidence.rationale: WaAAala allatheena hadoo harramna kulla thee thufurin wamina albaqari waalghanami harramna AAalayhim shuhoomahuma illa ma hamalat thuhooruhuma awi alhawaya aw ma ikhtalata biAAathmin thalika jazaynahum bibaghyihim wainna lasadiqoona: explicit framing of Jewish dietary law as punitive recompense for baghy distinguished from fabricated taboos condemned earlier.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Punitive legislation as historical divine response to communal transgression
Contrast between divinely-imposed restrictions and human fabrication

candidates.urduLabel: التحريمات الغذائية اليهودية كجزاء عقابي: كل ذي ظفر حرم ومن البقر والغنم شحومهما إلا ما حملت ظهورهما أو الحوايا أو ما اختلط بعظم جزيناهم ببغيهم وإنا لصادقون
candidates.notes: Overlap with divine-wrath and halal-food. Jazaynahum bibaghyihim explicitly labels these restrictions as punishment not divine preference distinguishing them from Islamic dietary law grounded in mercy. Kulla thee thufurin provides taxonomic criterion (uncloven hoof) absent from Islamic prohibitions. Shuhoom-exception details anatomical specificity demonstrating precise legislative knowledge. Wainna lasadiqoona affirms truthfulness of this historical report against potential denial. Whether these restrictions remain binding or were abrogated is a scholarly question deferred to review.

candidates.label: Determinist excuse refuted by knowledge demand: associators say if Allah willed not associated nor fathers nor forbidden; thus denied before tasted punishment; say have knowledge produce? follow assumption falsifying; Allah conclusive argument if willed guided all
candidates.definition: In 6:148-149: Those who associated with Allah will say If Allah had willed we would not have associated anything and neither would our fathers nor would we have prohibited anything. Likewise did those before deny until they tasted Our punishment. Say Do you have any knowledge that you can produce for us? You follow not except assumption and you are not but falsifying. Say With Allah is the far-reaching argument. If He had willed He would have guided you all.

evidence.excerpt: سَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشۡرَكۡنَا وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمۡنَا مِن شَيۡءٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ ذَاقُواْ بَأۡسَنَاۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ عِندَكُم مِّنۡ عِلۡمٖ فَتُخۡرِجُوهُ لَنَآۖ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَخۡرُصُونَ
evidence.rationale: Sayaqoolu allatheena ashrakoo law shaa Allahu ma ashrakna wala abaona wala harramna min shayin kathalika kaththaba allatheena min qablihim hatta thaqoo basana qul hal AAindakum min AAilmin fatukhrijoohu lana in tattabiAAoona illa alththanna wain antum illa takhrusoona: predicted determinist plea met with epistemic demand exposing assumption-following rather than metaphysical counter-argument.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحُجَّةُ ٱلۡبَٰلِغَةُۖ فَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
evidence.rationale: Qul falillahi alhujjatu albalighatu falaw shaa lahadakum ajmaAAeena: conclusive argument reserved to Allah with universal-guidance capacity affirmed without resolving tension between divine will and human responsibility.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Determinist excuse addressed without full metaphysical resolution
Epistemic demand shifting debate from ontology to evidence

candidates.urduLabel: دحض الحجة القدرية بالمطالبة بالعلم: قال الذين أشركوا لو شاء الله ما أشركنا ولا آباؤنا ولا حرمنا من شيء؛ كذلك كذب الذين من قبلهم حتى ذاقوا بأسنا؛ قل هل عندكم من علم فتخرجوه لنا إن تتبعون إلا الظن وإن أنتم إلا تخرصون؛ فلله الحجة البالغة فلو شاء لهداكم أجمعين
candidates.notes: Overlap with predestination-free-will and knowledge-ignorance. Law shaa Allahu ma ashrakna represents classic determinist defense attributing shirk to divine will. Kathalika kaththaba allatheena min qablihim hatta thaqoo basana invokes historical precedent showing this excuse failed previous communities. Hal AAindakum min AAilmin fatukhrijoohu lana shifts ground from metaphysics to epistemology demanding positive evidence rather than accepting negative inference. Alththanna-takhrusoona diagnoses popular theology as assumption-falsification. Alhujjatu albalighatu reserves ultimate argument to divine prerogative. Falaw shaa lahadakum ajmaAAeena affirms universal guidance capacity without explaining why it is not exercised leaving theological tension intact for scholarly engagement.

candidates.label: Two excuses cancelled by bayyinah arrival: scripture only sent to two groups before unaware of study; or would have been better guided; clear proof guidance mercy now come; worst punishment turning away signs
candidates.definition: In 6:156-157: Lest you say The Scripture was only sent down to two groups before us but we were of their study unaware. Or lest you say If only the Scripture had been revealed to us we would have been better guided than they. So there has now come to you a clear evidence from your Lord and a guidance and mercy. Then who is more unjust than one who denies the verses of Allah and turns away from them? We will recompense those who turn away from Our verses with the worst of punishment for their having turned away.

evidence.excerpt: أَن تَقُولُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ عَلَىٰ طَآئِفَتَيۡنِ مِن قَبۡلِنَا وَإِن كُنَّا عَن دِرَاسَتِهِمۡ لَغَٰفِلِينَ
evidence.rationale: An taqooloo innama onzila alkitabu AAala taifatayni min qablina wain kunna AAan dirasatihim laghafileena: first excuse anticipating ignorance-of-earlier-scripture claim preemptively cancelled.

evidence.excerpt: أَوۡ تَقُولُواْ لَوۡ أَنَّآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ لَكُنَّآ أَهۡدَىٰ مِنۡهُمۡۚ فَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم بَيِّنَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞۚ فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَصَدَفَ عَنۡهَاۗ سَنَجۡزِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَصۡدِفُونَ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَصۡدِفُونَ
evidence.rationale: Aw taqooloo law anna onzila AAalayna alkitabu lakunna ahda minhum faqad jaakum bayyinatun min rabbikum wahudan warahmatun faman athlamu mimman kaththaba biayati Allahi wasadafa AAanha sanajzee allatheena yasdifoona AAan ayatina sooa alAAathabi bima kanoo yasdifoona: second excuse anticipating comparative-superiority claim cancelled by bayyinah arrival with worst-punishment proportioned to turning-away.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Bayyinah as culminating revelation cancelling prior excuses
Worst punishment specifically linked to active turning-away not mere ignorance

candidates.urduLabel: إبطال العذرين بمجيء البينة: الكتاب أنزل على طائفتين من قبلنا كنا عن دراستهم لغافلين؛ أو لو أنزل علينا الكتاب لكنا أهدى منهم؛ قد جاءكم بينة من ربكم وهدى ورحمة؛ سوء العذاب لمن صدّف عن الآيات
candidates.notes: Overlap with quran-revelation-process and divine-wrath. Taifatayni identifies two earlier scripture-bearing communities (Jews and Christians) whose study was accessible. Laghafileena acknowledges genuine unawareness as potentially valid excuse now removed. Lakunna ahda minhum captures competitive superiority claim common in inter-religious polemic. Bayyinatun min rabbikum wahudan warahmatun defines current revelation as simultaneously evidential guiding and merciful. Sadoo AAanha (turning away) specifies active rejection not passive ignorance as culpable act. Sooaa alAAathabi bima kanoo yasdifoona establishes proportionality between punishment and deliberate aversion.

candidates.label: Sectarian fragmentation disowned: divided religion became sects prophet not associated with them affair only with Allah then informs what they did
candidates.definition: In 6:159: Indeed those who have divided their religion and become sects you O Muhammad are not associated with them in anything. Their affair is only left to Allah then He will inform them about what they used to do.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُواْ دِينَهُمۡ وَكَانُواْ شِيَعٗا لَّسۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ فِي شَيۡءٍۚ إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُمۡ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Inna allatheena farraqoo deenahum wakanoo shiyaAAan lasta minhum fee shayin innama amruhum ila Allahi thumma yunabbiohum bima kanoo yafAAaloona: prophetic dissociation from sectarian division with affair-deferral to divine judgment preventing premature coercion or alignment.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Sectarian division as antithesis of unified community
Divine informing as ultimate resolution of sectarian disputes

candidates.urduLabel: نبذ التفرق المذهبي: فرقوا دينهم وكانوا شيعاً لست منهم في شيء إنما أمرهم إلى الله ثم ينبئهم بما كانوا يفعلون
candidates.notes: Overlap with brotherhood-islam and day-of-judgment. Farraqoo deenahum identifies religion-division as active verb not passive drift. ShiyaAAan names factionalism as structural outcome of division. Lasta minhum fee shayin provides absolute prophetic dissociation preventing appropriation of messenger's authority for sectarian purposes. Innama amruhum ila Allahi defers resolution exclusively to divine jurisdiction removing human enforcement. Yunabbiohum bima kanoo yafAAaloona promises future clarification without specifying timing or mechanism. Which groups constitute shiyaAA and whether intra-Muslim disagreement qualifies are scholarly questions deferred to review.

candidates.label: Asymmetric recompense and sole devotion: good deed tenfold evil only equivalent not wronged; prayer sacrifice living dying for Allah Lord worlds no partner commanded first Muslims
candidates.definition: In 6:160-163: Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof and whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof and they will not be wronged. Say Indeed my prayer my rites of sacrifice my living and my dying are for Allah Lord of the worlds. No partner has He. And this I have been commanded and I am the first of the Muslims.

evidence.excerpt: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ عَشۡرُ أَمۡثَالِهَاۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجۡزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثۡلَهَا وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Man jaa bialhasanati falahu AAashru amthaliha waman jaa bialssayyiati fala yujza illa mithlaha wahum la yuthlamoona: asymmetric moral economy establishing tenfold credit for good versus exact equivalence for evil with injustice-negation.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحۡيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Qul inna salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbi alAAalameena: fourfold total-life devotion spanning ritual sustenance existence and death directed exclusively to Rabb al-AAalameen.

evidence.excerpt: لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُۥۖ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرۡتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: La shareeka lahu wabithalika omirtu waana awwalu almuslimeena: partner-negation command-affirmation and priority-declaration forming confessional climax.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Total devotion as practical expression of exclusive lordship
Recompense asymmetry favoring good over evil as divine generosity

candidates.urduLabel: الجزاء غير المتماثل والتفاني الخالص: بالحسنة عشر أمثالها وبالسيئة مثلها لا يظلمون؛ صلاتي ونسكي ومحياي ومماتي لله رب العالمين لا شريك له بذلك أمرت وأنا أول المسلمين
candidates.notes: Overlap with tawheed and justice. AAashru amthaliha establishes divine generosity multiplier exceeding strict justice. Illa mithlaha limits evil-recompense to equivalence preventing excessive punishment. La yuthlamoona negates any injustice in either direction. Salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee extends devotion beyond ritual to encompass entire existence. Rabbi alAAalameen universalizes lordship beyond tribal or national deity. La shareeka lahu provides absolute monotheistic formula. Wabithalika omirtu grounds confession in received command not self-generated piety. Awwalu almuslimeena claims priority in submission establishing prophetic exemplarity.

candidates.label: Individual accountability and khilaafah trial: seek other than Allah lord? Lord everything; soul earns only against itself bearer bears not burden another; return Lord informs differed; successors earth raised degrees test given; swift penalty Forgiving Merciful
candidates.definition: In 6:164-165: Say Is it other than Allah I should desire as a lord while He is the Lord of all things? And every soul earns not except against itself and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return and He will inform you concerning that over which you used to differ. And it is He who has made you successors upon the earth and has raised some of you above others in degrees that He may try you through what He has given you. Indeed your Lord is swift in penalty but indeed He is Forgiving and Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبۡغِي رَبّٗا وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖۚ وَلَا تَكۡسِبُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ
evidence.rationale: Qul aghayra Allahi abghee rabban wahuwa rabbu kulli shayin wala taksibu kullu nafsin illa AAalayha wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra thumma ila rabbikum marjiAAukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum feehi takhtalifoona: sole-lordship rhetorical question combined with individual earning-principle and non-transferable burden establishing absolute personal accountability.

evidence.excerpt: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَكُمۡ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَرَفَعَ بَعۡضَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ فِي مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۡۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمُۢ
evidence.rationale: Wahuwa allathee jaAAalakum khalaifa alardi warafaAAa baAAdakum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyabluwakum fee ma atakum inna rabbaka sareeAAu alAAiqabi wainnahu laghafoorun raheemun: khilaafah-station with rank-differentiation framed as trial-purpose closed by swift-penalty and forgiveness-mercy pairing.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Earth-succession as appointed station with testing function
Rank inequality reframed as divine trial rather than inherent superiority
Non-transferable burden establishing irreducible individual responsibility

candidates.urduLabel: المسؤولية الفردية وابتلاء الخلافة: أغير الله أبغي رباً وهو رب كل شيء؛ لا تكسب كل نفس إلا عليها ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى؛ إلى ربكم مرجعكم فينبئكم بما كنتم فيه تختلفون؛ جعلكم خلفاء الأرض ورفع بعضكم فوق بعض درجات ليبلوكم فيما آتاكم؛ سريع العقاب وغفور رحيم
candidates.notes: Overlap with khalifah-concept trial-and-test and self-accountability. Aghayra Allahi abghee rabban uses interrogative-negation eliminating alternative lordship possibilities. Rabbu kulli shayin universalizes divine authority matching 6:162 rabb al-AAalameen. Wala taksibu kullu nafsin illa AAalayha establishes earning-confined-to-self principle. Wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra provides most explicit non-transferability statement in Quran. Fayunabbiokum bima kuntum feehi takhtalifoona promises future clarification of present disputes. Khalaifa alardi defines human earth-station as delegated succession not ownership. Darajatin liyabluwakum reframes social hierarchy as testing mechanism rather than merit-indicator. Fee ma atakum locates trial in what is given not what is achieved. SareeAAu alAAiqabi laghafoorun raheemun closes surah with balanced attributes preventing despair or presumption.
